title: The Twilight Zone Radio Dramas
paragraphs: Full-cast audio adaptations that revisit stories associated with The Twilight Zone for radio, using a recurring host and new performers while preserving the series' science-fiction, fantasy, and moral-twist storytelling.

Licensed full-cast audio anthology hosted/narrated by Stacy Keach. GRH contains the complete 176-title radio release set: 155 titles correspond to episodes/presentations in the 1959-64 television run and 21 are special/non-TV radio entries including unrealized scripts, precursor material and original radio stories.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Falcon syndicated radio-drama era (2002 to 2012).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Stacy Keach (narrator and performer), Dennis Etchison (radio adaptor and writer), Mike Starr (performer), Stan Freberg (performer), Blair Underwood (performer), Chelcie Ross (performer), and Tim Kazurinsky (performer).

The stories often return to identity and unstable reality, time, memory and alternate reality, technology and dehumanization, mortality, aging and death, conformity, prejudice and social pressure, and isolation and alienation.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Classic television stories remade for modern radio, Celebrity-led syndicated audio drama revival, and Unproduced Twilight Zone scripts realized in audio.
